verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Ollama can pull models via 'ollama pull' from its registry, and community notes mention 'new model on HF or Ollama registry' being pullable, implying some Hugging Face model support, but no first-party docs explicitly detail a direct 'ollama pull hf.co/...' workflow or GGUF-from-HF import process in this pack. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Hugging Face direct download/import syntax, confirmation of supported model formats from HF, and independent hands-on verification of the HF pull flow.
